result:
I've finished the QA-E continuation and written the handback; nothing is committed. All three acceptance suites are delivered, and every suite ran on integrated HEAD `60535e99`, since BE-X4, BE-X5 and QA-F had not merged yet. The DLV-038 run shows that REQ-DLV-038 does not pass on this tree: two known product defects fail every time, and the Keycloak login spec is BLOCKED. This was an authoring task, not the DG6 gate review, so there is no review verdict.

**Who wrote what.** QA-E wrote the A22 support helper, the A22 and A01 integration tests and the A22 e2e spec. I reviewed them and made these changes:
- **A22 test:** stale-version and repeat acknowledge/resolve checks now require exactly 409, as the contract says; before, they also accepted 412 or 422. I added health and readiness checks, including 503 on an unmigrated database, which no earlier A22 suite asserted, plus the P6 alert job in the jobs view.
- **A01 test:** QA-E's header said the TOM canvas accepts an edit, but no test did one. I added it: the lead's edit returns 200 and the read-only auditor gets 403.
- **New load-report check** (`tests/qa/unit/dlv038-s20-029-load-report.test.ts`): recomputes all 18 p95 figures and counts in DO-G's load report from the raw samples; they match exactly. That clears the "QA-E verification pending" note on REQ-S20-029. I did not re-run the load itself.

**Checks**

| Check | Exit | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DG5 historical validation, start and end | 0 / 0 | PASS |
| A22 integration | 0 | 17/17 |
| A01 integration | 0 | 11/11 |
| A22 e2e, English and Arabic | 0 | 2/2, axe 0 serious or critical issues on 5 screens per language |
| Full `tests/qa` integration | 1 | 430/431; only `a17-import-and-integration` fails (P-1) |
| `tests/qa` unit | 0 | 35/35 |
| Root e2e, dev stack | 1 | 147 passed, 10 failed, 18 skipped, 3 did not run |
| Root e2e, demo stack | 0 | 12/12 |
| Keycloak login spec | 0 | BLOCKED: no Keycloak or container runtime here; 4 skipped |
| A18 clean start | 0 | PASS (install step not run, as the assignment requires) |
| `pnpm lint`; repo-wide Prettier | 0 / 0 | clean |
| Mutation checks M1–M7 | 1 each, as intended | 7/7 caught: A22 logs, heartbeat, alert, version check and log scan; A01; load report |

Two non-zero exits in my own work, both disclosed:
- **First Vitest run:** didn't start, because `node_modules` is read-only in the sandbox. Every later run uses `--configLoader runner`, as an earlier QA task did.
- **First run of my new load-report test:** hit the 5 s default timeout on the loaded host. I moved the parsing out of the test instead of raising the timeout.

**Findings**

| ID | Severity (proposed) | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P-1 | High, mandatory | REQ-S12-019: after a failing connector run, `GET /api/v1/admin/operations/exceptions/{id}` returns the linked KPI as `freshness: "unknown"` with no last value, where the row requires Stale, `"250.75"` and 2026-01-31. Fails in integration and in e2e (both languages), in the full run and alone. Already known; BE-X4 is the open repair. |
| P-2 | High | REQ-S17-007 / A12-5: a signed-in Transformation Lead never sees the assistant launcher while the assistant is on. Fails in both languages, in the full run and alone. BE-X5 is the open repair. |
| Q-1 | Low | Tests only: the A21 degradation spec fails after the A12 spec in a shared stack, because A12 leaves the assistant configured. It passes 4/4 alone. |
| Q-2 | Low | Tests only: the A20 keyboard test failed once in Arabic in the full run and passes 14/14 alone. |
| Q-3 | Info | My mistake: I didn't export the webhook signing secret in the full run. Re-run alone with a synthetic secret: 10/10. |

A12-6 in Arabic also failed once in the full run (the sign-in field didn't appear within 5 s at load average about 15). It passed alone; I report both runs.

**Still to do**
- After BE-X4 and BE-X5 merge, repeat the DLV-038 run on the frozen candidate with the webhook secret exported and the A21 spec on its own stack.
- Keycloak stays BLOCKED until a test IdP is available.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/T-DG6-QA-E-authoring/`; open `handback.md` first. It has the full requirement → test table, the logs, the mutation diffs and the failure screenshots. The run took 04:12:18Z to about 05:13Z, within the time limit.
